title: theme tests: share one readText helper instead of three copies of the node:fs workaround

v: From review of board siren-edge-march-hook (spec decision 01M59MHVXMRJTDF36AN62WB9SF). The process.getBuiltinModule("node:fs") + import.meta.dirname cast block appears three times: packages/core/src/theme/default.test.ts (top of file and again near the CSS-reading test around line 1341) and packages/core/src/theme/readme-tokens.test.ts (readText). The comment-stripping regex and the :root extraction regex are repeated too. Move them into one small test helper module next to the tests so a change to the no-@types/node workaround is made once. Behaviour-neutral refactor; all src/theme tests must stay green.

body: Done by board theme-test-reader (spec 01M5EBJRJ0W3CN3RJKM227PZ3J): packages/core/src/theme/testing/stylesheet.ts owns readBeside and the CSSOM reader; the three getBuiltinModule copies are gone (commits 9d9461c, 0d79f8c, 08ca6b6).
